note.note:
I cannot generate the requested Problem List Clinical Note because the consult transcript and DDx were not included. Please paste the raw transcript and the DDx JSON so I can synthesize them into the exact structured note you requested.

What I need from you
- The full raw transcript (doctor–patient conversation). Include any short audio/text fragments; mark inaudible sections if present.
- The DDx JSON (diagnostic reasoning output) as provided.
- If available, explicitly include: medications, allergies, past medical history, vitals, physical exam findings, and any management/advice given during the consult.

Helpful formatting tips
- Put the transcript between clear delimiters (e.g., <<<transcript>>>).
- Put the DDx JSON between clear delimiters (e.g., <<<ddx>>>).
- If the transcript is long, it’s OK to paste the full text; I will extract only clinically relevant information.
- If you want me to redact identifying patient details, say so.

If you prefer, you can also paste a shorter summary of the consult (presenting complaint, timeline, meds/allergies, exam findings, and plan) and I will create the structured Problem List Clinical Note from that.

Example of what to paste (minimal needed)
- Transcript:
  - “Patient: I have had left knee pain for 3 weeks after twisting it. Worse with walking. No fever. Dr: Exam shows swelling and limited flexion. No neurovascular deficit. Advised RICE, analgesia, physio.”
- DDx JSON:
  - [{"diagnosis":"Lateral meniscal tear","likelihood":"moderate","justification":"mechanism and joint line pain"},{"diagnosis":"Ligament sprain","likelihood":"high","justification":"acute twisting injury with effusion"}]

I will then produce the Problem List Clinical Note using the exact structure and headings you requested, and include quality checks at the end.
